full_judgment:
2. The petitioners as plaintiffs instituted a suit being Title Suit No. 51 of 1998 before the Court of learned Senior Assistant Judge, Noagaon for declaration that registered deed No. 8036 of 1969 is fraudulent, illegal, null and void. The short case of the plaintiffs is that Lalu Mondal was the original owner and possessor of the suit land as mentioned in the plaint. Accordingly, 8 annas share appertaining to SA Khatian No. 27 was duly recorded in his name. Lalu Mondal died leaving behind his 3 sons namely Abdus Samad, Abdus Sobhan and Kalimuddin as his legal heirs. Thereafter, Abdus Sobhan died leaving behind his wife, the plaintiff No. 2 and sons as the plaintiff Nos. 3-6 and plaintiff Nos. 7-9 as his legal heirs. Kalimuddin died leaving behind his wife, the plaintiff No. 10 and sons as the plaintiff Nos. 11- 14 and plaintiff Nos. 13-14 as his legal heirs. Lalu Mondal gifted 5 gandas of land orally to Kachiran alias Kachiman and Tafijan Bibi. After that, Kachiran left this transitory world behind the defendant Nos. 2-5 as her sons. Tafijan died leaving behind Majeda Khatun as her heir. While the plaintiff No. 2 was in possession of the suit land having received summons of Criminal Case No. 100C/1998, she came to know that the defendant No. 1 instituted the said case claiming that the suit land owned and possessed by his mother Aysha Bibi. After going through the petition of the aforesaid case, the plaintiff came to know that by false personification, Aysha Bibi created the impugned deed dated 11-6-1969 bearing No. 8036. In the aforesaid backdrop, the plaintiffs brought the suit for proper redress and relief. 

 5. After that, Lalu and Aysha possessed the suit land and accordingly, SA Khatian No. 27 was duly prepared in their name. After the sad demise of Lalu Mondal, his heirs sold the property to Aysha Bibi on 11-6-1969 by registered deed No. 8036. She paid rent to the Government and submitted statement including the said land to the Government. But unfortunately, the plaintiff brought this false suit in order to harass the defendants, therefore, the same is liable to be dismissed with costs. 

 10. On perusal of the record, it is seen that DW 2 Md Afir Uddin Mondal in his evidence clearly stated "আমি ৮০৩৬নং দলিল এর সনাক্তকারী, দাতা কছিমন আমার মা, সে ৮০৩৬ নং দলিল সম্পাদন করে দেয় টিপ দিয়া, আমি টিপ সনাক্তকারী” By way of cross-examination, the plaintiff could not shake his evidence. The impugned deed was marked as Exhibit ka(1). The SA Khatian was examined as Exhibit ka(5), while RS Khatian was marked as Exhibit Ka(6). Mutation Khatian, DCR and Rent Receipt were proved and marked as Exhibit Ka(7-14) respectively. Exhibit ka(1) is more than 30 years old deed and the custody of the said deed has been duly proved.
